title: ADR Audit
description: Architecture decisions found in the repository, each checked against the project graph. Four outcomes and only four; the important one is `unverifiable`, because when there is no evidence to check against, saying so is the honest answer and reporting conformance would be a claim the audit did not earn. The audit never changes a decision's lifecycle — superseding a decision is a human act.

adr.description: Repo-relative path, forward slashes — what a reader opens.

status.description: The decision's own declared status: accepted, superseded, proposed…

date.description: As written in the ADR. Present so the set can be read in the order the decisions were taken.

assertion.description: The checkable claim this audit derived from the decision.

requiresHumanDecision.description: True when the audit found something only a person can resolve. The audit proposes; it never supersedes.
